facts.fact: The Deputy Minister in The Presidency told the Portfolio Committee that the Statistics Amendment Act, No. 29 of 2024, was proclaimed for implementation on 1 October 2025, strengthening coordination of statistical production across government.

note: Only the commencement of the amendment act is stated; no rule made or act done under the law is dated, so no reach fact.

facts.fact: A parliamentary committee report of 23 June 2026 records Stats SA briefing it on 28 April 2026 on its proposed amendment of the Statistics Act (No. 6 of 1999), so the 1999 Act is the law in force, and lists rolling out amendments under Act No. 29 of 2024 as a 2026 priority.

note: Regulations and about 20 MoUs are said to be under development for the amendments: no dated rule made and no dated act under the law, so no reach fact.

facts.fact: This document is the text of the Statistics Amendment Act, 2024 (Act 29 of 2024), which amends the Statistics Act, 1999; the President assented on 10 December 2024 and it was published in Government Gazette 51805 on 20 December 2024.
